description: Extract complaint signals from negative (critical, 1-3 star) reviews for one ASIN. Tags each complaint review with human-readable themes (quality_defect, battery_power, connectivity, comfort_fit, sound_quality, shipping_delivery, returns_refunds, value_price, authenticity, app_software) using a transparent English keyword heuristic — not a classifier. Optionally filter to complaints with at least minHelpful helpful votes.

minHelpful.description: Only keep complaints with at least this many helpful votes.

pageCount.description: Review pages to fetch (~10 reviews per page). Each page bills credits on the Pangolinfo account — see billing notes.

name: mine_complaints
